item.title: Currying and Partial Functions
item.description: 1. What Currying Is According to the Wikipedia entry, in computer science currying is the technique of converting a function that takes multiple arguments into a function that takes a single argument (the first argument of the original function), and returns a new function that accepts the remaining arguments and returns a result.
